mqtt_host.title: MQTT broker host
mqtt_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the broker used by Ring.

mqtt_tls.title: Use TLS
mqtt_tls.description: Require a server certificate trusted by the worker's TLS roots.

mqtt_topics.title: MQTT topic filters
mqtt_topics.description: Up to 16 provider-specific filters separated by semicolons. Only complete identity segments may use +; global # filters are rejected.

camera_labels.title: Camera names
camera_labels.description: Optional camera names keyed by location/device.

snapshot_base_url.title: Snapshot HTTP base address
snapshot_base_url.description: Direct HTTP(S) origin and path prefix for snapshots, without credentials, query or fragment. Leave blank for notifications only.

snapshot_url_template.title: Private snapshot URL template
snapshot_url_template.description: Optional HTTP(S) URL within the configured base. Supports {location_id}, {device_id}, and {event}. Query credentials remain private.

snapshot_bearer_token.title: Snapshot bearer token
snapshot_bearer_token.description: Optional token sent only to the configured snapshot origin and path. No Home Assistant credentials are inherited.
